message.content:
Here are some effective exercises that target the major muscle groups in your legs—quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves, and hip stabilizers. Try to include a mix of compound movements (which work multiple joints and muscles) and isolation exercises (which focus on a single muscle group). Aim for 2–3 sets of 8–15 reps per exercise, adjusting weight or resistance so the last few reps feel challenging but doable.

| Exercise | Primary Muscles Worked | Tips |
|----------|------------------------|------|
| **Squats** (bodyweight, goblet, barbell back/ front) | Quads, hamstrings, glutes, core | Keep chest up, knees tracking over toes, depth to parallel or below |
| **Deadlifts** (conventional, sumo, Romanian) | Hamstrings, glutes, lower back, traps | Maintain neutral spine, engage core, pull through heels |
| **Lunges** (forward, reverse, walking, Bulgarian split squat) | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Step far enough to keep knee behind toes, keep torso upright |
| **Leg Press** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Adjust foot placement to target different areas; avoid locking knees |
| **Step‑Ups** | Quads, glutes, calves | Use a sturdy platform; drive through the heel of the stepping leg |
| **Hip Thrusts / Glute Bridges** | Glutes, hamstrings | Squeeze glutes at top, avoid arching lower back |
| **Calf Raises** (standing, seated, on leg press) | Calves (gastrocnemius, soleus) | Full range of motion, pause at peak contraction |
| **Hamstring Curls** (lying, seated, standing) | Hamstrings | Control eccentric phase, avoid swinging |
| **Leg Extensions** | Quads | Use light weight, avoid locking knees |
| **Side‑Leg Raises / Clamshells** | Hip abductors, glute medius | Keep pelvis stable, avoid hip rotation |
| **Box Jumps / Plyometric Jumps** | Quads, glutes, calves, core | Land softly, keep knees slightly bent |

### Sample 3‑Day Split (Leg‑Focused)

| Day | Warm‑Up | Main Sets | Accessory / Conditioning |
|-----|---------|-----------|---------------------------|
| **Leg Day 1** | 5‑min light cardio + dynamic stretches | Squats 4×6‑8, Leg Press 3×10‑12, Walking Lunges 3×12‑15 | Calf Raises 3×15‑20 |
| **Leg Day 2** | 5‑min light cardio + dynamic stretches | Deadlifts 4×5‑6, Hip Thrusts 3×8‑10, Bulgarian Split Squats 3×10‑12 | Side‑Leg Raises 3×15‑20 |
| **Leg Day 3** | 5‑min light cardio + dynamic stretches | Front Squats 3×6‑8, Leg Curls 3×10‑12, Box Jumps 3×8 | Seated Calf Raises 3×15‑20 |

Feel free to adjust volume, intensity, or exercise selection based on your goals (strength, hypertrophy, endurance) and any equipment limitations. If you have any injuries or specific concerns, let me know and I can tailor the routine further!
